operation.summary: Rotate the Standard Webhooks signing key to a receiver-provisioned value; previous key remains for 24 hours; same-value retries do not rotate again; explicit owner.configuration grant required; no per-change phone approval

body.name: signing_secret
body.description: whsec_ + base64 of 32 random bytes known to the receiver

operation.returns: safe configured status; neither old nor new key returned
